_note: The seasonal shop tiles on the front page (founder, 25 Nov 2026: the stale archive section came off for the seasonal range, linked to the shop) and, through build-feed.mjs, the app's /feed/home-covers.json. One tile per product on https://shop.thearchv.ca: `handle` is the Shopify handle (the link is https://shop.thearchv.ca/products/<handle>), `name` is the product title copied verbatim from the shop, `image` is the shop's first product photo at 900x675 WebP under public/shop/ (the square photo centred on its own white ground, metadata stripped), `alt` describes that photo. `home` (1 to 4) picks the front page's four and their order; the app gets the same four. Rotating the season is an edit here plus a deploy: read https://shop.thearchv.ca/products.json for handles and titles, and never link a product the shop does not list.
